title: Heroes of Wallaby
tagline: Heroes Of Wallaby - Pixel Adventure Game with Staking and Rewards
description: Mint your NFT hero and stake FIL to earn in-game rewards. Explore creepy dungeons, fight 28 different enemies and earn gold to increase your stake. Pick the dungeon difficulty carefully, easier dungeons offer smaller rewards and are less risky. Avoid the DeGen Mode  - large rewards are found there, yet the risks are far greater. Players can burn the NFT characters anytime to access their stake and rewards.
how_its_made:
The project is deployed on Filecoin FVM. It uses Next.js for front-end & API, MUI as UI library and Ethers.js for smart contract calls. The code is deployed on Vercel. Socket.io is used for server-client sync. Game library used is Kaboom. 
Wallet connect is done with Rainbow Me. Game art generated with MidJourney AI.
